verdicts.reason: A: the Lumen & Fig logo has shrunk to an unreadable speck and fallen outside the card onto the leaves, the card is jammed against the top edge, and the 'NEW NIGHT SERUM' eyebrow sits below the body copy, which breaks the reading order. B keeps the logo legible and inside the card, but it is crammed against the bottom edge, the card runs flush to the top and bottom of the canvas, the eyebrow is still below the body copy, and the bottle is squeezed into the left margin.
